messages:
Maya Chen: Quick sync — I ran into multiple docs PRs using 'a11y' vs 'accessibility' and mixed param casing for config keys. We should define a short rule set for edgecases (abbrev, acronyms in UI copy, and SDK snippet param_case). Thoughts?
Liam O'Connor: +1. Suggestions: UI copy uses full words for user-facing labels (use 'Accessibility' not 'A11Y'), internal docs and code snippets can mention the common abbreviation in parentheses once. Example: 'Accessibility (A11Y)'.
Samir Patel: For SDK snippets, prefer snake_case for config keys in examples when the real SDK uses snake_case; otherwise match actual SDK. We should add a note: "match runtime API exactly". Also add lint rule check? :thinking: 
Julia Ramos: Accessibility team agrees — users see UI, so full word. For technical glossary entries ok to keep 'a11y' but always link to the accessibility page. Also flag that screen reader labels must be explicit.
Patrick Nguyen: I'll open a glossary entry and link PR. Also propose a tiny section in the style guide: 'How to introduce acronyms' with one example.
docs-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321 by @patrick — title: 'docs: add naming edgecases + acronyms guidance' :rocket: 
Maya Chen: Thanks — @Patrick can you include a 2-line checklist for reviewers (UI vs code samples)? Also @Samir please add linter suggestion like `yarn docs:lint --rules acronyms` if possible.
Samir Patel: On it. Draft snippet for the guide:
```
Guideline: Use full words in user-facing copy. Introduce abbreviations once in parentheses in technical docs: "Accessibility (A11Y)". Match SDK param naming to runtime API exactly.
```
Liam O'Connor: Suggest deadline EOW for the PR. If no objections, merge after a quick UX + SDK review. :thumbsup: 
Maya Chen: EOW works. I'll do the UX review. @Julia please confirm accessibility wording before merge. :eyes: 
Julia Ramos: Will review by Friday. :white_check_mark: 
Patrick Nguyen: PR updated with glossary entry and checklist. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321/files
docs-bot: Deploy preview: https://deploy-preview-4321--docs.redwood.ai :sparkles: 
Samir Patel: Added linter proposal in the PR comments — includes `acronyms` rule + sample mapping file.
Maya Chen: Perfect. Thanks everyone. Closing thread after merge. :wave:
